description: Manages user-defined saved search configurations, allowing users to store and reuse complex search criteria for various entities.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Creates a new saved filter based on provided criteria. This allows users to store a specific search configuration for future use.

EntityType.description: The type of entity this filter applies to (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact')

SearchCriteria.description: JSON string representing the advanced search criteria

SearchText.description: General search text for basic searches

IsAdvancedSearch.description: Indicates if the filter uses advanced search criteria

Ascending.description: Order direction (true for ascending, false for descending)

example_uses: Create a new saved filter named 'My Partner Filter' for partners, with specific criteria.
Save a complex search for 'Active Projects' that includes multiple conditions.
Can you create a saved filter for me that searches for contacts in 'New York' and is marked as advanced search?
I want to save a filter for all 'High Priority' tasks.
Please create a saved filter for all 'Open' cases, ordered by 'CreationDate' ascending.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to save a specific search configuration, including advanced criteria, for future reuse across different entity types.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Updates an existing saved filter identified by its ID. This allows modification of its name, description, or search criteria.

Id.description: Unique identifier of the saved filter to update

Name.description: New name for the saved filter

Description.description: New description for the saved filter

SearchCriteria.description: Updated JSON string representing the advanced search criteria

SearchText.description: Updated general search text for basic searches

IsAdvancedSearch.description: Indicates if the filter uses advanced search criteria

OrderBy.description: New field to order results by

Ascending.description: New order direction (true for ascending, false for descending)

example_uses: Update the saved filter with ID 123 to change its name to 'Archived Projects'.
Modify the search criteria of filter 456 to include a new condition.
Can you update saved filter 789 to change its description?
I need to update the saved filter 'My Contacts' to sort by 'LastName' ascending.
Please update filter 101 to use advanced search and provide new search criteria.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the details or search criteria of an already saved filter.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Deletes a saved filter by its unique identifier. This action is irreversible.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to delete

example_uses: Delete the saved filter with ID 123.
Remove the 'Old Tasks' saved filter.
Can you delete saved filter 789?
I want to delete the filter I created yesterday.
Please remove the saved filter with ID 555.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a saved filter is no longer needed and should be permanently removed.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a specific saved filter by its ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to retrieve

example_uses: Get the details of saved filter with ID 123.
Retrieve the configuration for the 'My Partner Filter'.
Can you show me the details of saved filter 789?
I need to see the criteria for filter 101.
Please fetch the saved filter with ID 222.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to view the configuration and details of a particular saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of saved filters for the current user, with optional filtering by entity type or search text. This endpoint supports basic search capabilities for saved filters themselves.

request.description: Search and pagination parameters for saved filters

EntityType.description: Filter saved filters by the entity type they apply to (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact')

SearchText.description: General text to search within saved filter names or descriptions

OrderBy.description: Field to order the list of saved filters by (e.g., 'Name', 'CreationDate')

Ascending.description: Order direction (true for ascending, false for descending)

Direction.description: Alternative order direction parameter (true for ascending, false for descending)

PageIndex.description: The page number to retrieve (1-based index)

PageSize.description: The number of items per page

example_uses: List all saved filters for the current user.
Find saved filters related to 'Partner' entities.
Show me all saved filters that contain 'project' in their name or description, paginated.
Get the second page of saved filters, with 10 items per page, ordered by name.
Can you list all saved filters for 'Contact' entity type, sorted by creation date descending?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to list all saved filters or search for them by entity type or text, with pagination.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Applies a saved filter by its ID and returns the corresponding search request object (e.g., for a 'Partner' entity search) that can then be used with the actual search endpoint for that entity. This allows for advanced, pre-defined search criteria to be loaded and executed. Pagination parameters can be overridden.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to apply

pageIndex.description: Optional page index to override the saved filter's pagination settings (default: 1)

pageSize.description: Optional page size to override the saved filter's pagination settings (default: 10)

example_uses: Apply saved filter with ID 123 and get the search request object.
Retrieve the search criteria defined in 'My Complex Partner Search' filter.
Can you apply saved filter 456 and give me the request object, overriding page size to 20?
I need the search parameters from filter 789 to use in another query.
Please apply the filter 'All Active Users' and return the configured search request.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to retrieve the full search criteria and parameters defined within a saved filter, to then apply it to another entity's search endpoint.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Retrieves usage statistics for saved filters, optionally filtered by entity type. This can provide insights into which filters are most frequently used.

entityType.description: Optional entity type to filter statistics (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact')

example_uses: Get overall usage statistics for all saved filters.
Show me the usage statistics for saved filters related to 'Partner' entities.
Can you provide statistics on how often filters for 'Projects' are used?
I need to see the most popular saved filters.
Please get the statistics for saved filters, specifically for the 'Interaction' entity type.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to see statistics or trends related to the usage of saved filters.
